def run_sync(fetch, max_items, max_retries=None):
    items = []
    attempts = 0
    while len(items) < max_items:
        attempts += 1
        try:
            items.extend(fetch(len(items)))
        except IOError:
            continue
    return items[: max_items - 1]
EOF
